name: Wheat germ, crude
source: Proximate composition (per kg): water 111 g, protein 232 g, fat 97 g, ash 43 g, carbohydrate by difference 517 g, typical of crude wheat germ (USDA FoodData Central pattern).
notes: Same conversion method as wheat-grain. Germ is the grain's most protein- and fat-dense fraction, which shows up as a higher N and C share than bran or flour.
